title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Danfo Livery. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Danfo Livery
options.lineage: Lagos danfo buses: sign-painted yellow flanks, black stripes, back-window slogans
options.thesis: Your career rides the route like a Lagos danfo: sign-painted, loud, and always moving.
materials: enamel sign paint on steel panels
options.viewport: Full-yellow bus flank: two black stripes, a painted slogan headline, the route board calling LAGOS to REMOTE, and the CV as a fare ticket you tear off.
options.risk: Reads as costume to international recruiters if the lettering is timid or facts get buried in paint.

raised.raise: Every number on a panel carries its stop and date, so no claim floats without provenance.
Panels, stripes and type sit on one measured 12-column grid; nothing is placed by eye.
Recency sets the paint: current roles in fresh gloss, older stops in sun-faded enamel.
Depth planes: copy rides the nearest plane while stripes and route board travel slower in 3D on scroll.
Total colour commitment: the page is danfo yellow end to end; black and one red do every other job.

options.label: Exploded Assembly Drawing
options.lineage: mechanical engineering drawing sets: title blocks, exploded isometrics, bills of materials
options.thesis: A mechanical engineer's drawing set where each shipped app explodes into its layers as you scroll.
options.viewport: A drawing title block (name, revision, sheet 1 of 5) beside MAX One PAMS exploded into five isometric layers that separate in 3D as you scroll.
options.risk: Topped my own list, and engineering-blueprint portfolios are a familiar move; it can read cold.

options.label: Boarding Pass & Gate Board
options.lineage: airline boarding passes and departure boards
options.thesis: Every shipped app is a departed flight; the CV is your boarding pass.
materials: segmented pass card with tabular figures
gate board rows that rerank in place
options.viewport: A pass for CALEB to YOUR TEAM whose scannable block downloads the CV, beside a board of apps flagged LIVE ON PLAY.
options.case: Fuses cleanly and every hiring manager reads a gate board instantly; loses on personality and Lagos ownership.
options.risk: A travel metaphor many portfolios have tried.

options.label: Treasure Map
options.thesis: The career as a map to decode.
options.viewport: A coastline of jobs with marginal clues.
options.case: Hiring managers skim; a world built on inference slows them down.
options.risk: Hides the facts the visitor came for.

options.label: Oscilloscope Bench
options.lineage: CRT oscilloscopes on a signal bench
options.thesis: Impact as measured signal on a graticule.
options.viewport: A downtime waveform dropping from 3h to 1h.
options.case: Instrument costume; hiring managers do not identify with a scope.
options.risk: Neon-on-black is the category's own rut.

options.label: Suminagashi Ink Basin
options.thesis: The page as a living fluid surface.
options.viewport: A WebGL ink basin behind a quiet name.
options.case: Beautiful but says nothing about shipping apps.
options.kept: The newest is always the darkest: recency sets weight.

options.label: Multiplane Cel Dawn
options.thesis: Scroll as a camera sinking through painted planes.
options.viewport: A forest dawn parallax down to a lit cottage.
options.case: Great scroll depth, but the forest has nothing to do with your work.
options.kept: Depth planes with text on the nearest one.

options.label: Indoor Weather Sun
options.lineage: a monofrequency sun in a hazed hall
options.viewport: A half sun with your silhouette mirrored above.
options.risk: Art installation, not a hiring page.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: The dark developer portfolio, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Name and role hero, a tilting 3D phone, then a bento grid of projects.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other developer portfolio by design.
